title: Clear Skies!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Magazine editor Taiga Obinata runs a crowded household of orphaned siblings. One night novelist Shuu Asuou, Taiga's old classmate and one of his own writers, turns up announcing he has married the family's eldest sister Shima, who then goes missing, so he stays. Two volumes of family comedy and drama adapted from Akira Sugano's novel series, with a slow boys' love thread (MU).
life_message: A chosen and inherited family that keeps its door open, even to someone it resents, is where people heal.
